references.text: Describes how thorns and thistles will grow in cursed places, which can be seen as a parallel to how thorns choke the seed in the parable.
Jeremiah uses the image of thorns as part of a warning, which may reflect how thorns hinder growth in the parable.
Luke's version of the Parable of the Sower, where the seed also falls among thorns that choke it.
Mark's version of the Parable of the Sower, which also describes how the seed is choked by thorns.
